SELECT a.frst_nm AS `名`, a.last_nm AS `姓`, COUNT(DISTINCT fa.ref1) AS `出演数`
FROM `actr` AS a
JOIN `flm_act` AS fa ON a.actr_id = fa.ref2
GROUP BY a.actr_id, a.frst_nm, a.last_nm
ORDER BY `出演数` DESC, `名` ASC, `姓` ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT a.frst_nm AS `名`, a.last_nm AS `姓`, COUNT(fa.ref2) AS `出演数` FROM actr a LEFT JOIN flm_act fa ON a.actr_id = fa.ref1 GROUP BY a.actr_id, a.frst_nm, a.last_nm ORDER BY `出演数` DESC, `名` ASC, `姓` ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT a.frst_nm, a.last_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT fa.ref2) AS movie_count
FROM actr a

ORDER BY movie_count DESC, a.frst_nm ASC, a.last_nm ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT c.frst_nm, c.last_nm, SUM(p.amt) AS amount

LIMIT 10

SELECT a.frst_nm, a.last_nm, COUNT(*) AS 获奖数
FROM actr a
JOIN awd w ON a.actr_id = w.ref1
GROUP BY a.actr_id, a.frst_nm, a.last_nm
ORDER BY 获奖数 DESC, a.frst_nm ASC, a.last_nm ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT a.frst_nm AS `名`, a.last_nm AS `姓`, COUNT(w.awd_id) AS `获奖数`

SELECT a.frst_nm, a.last_nm, COUNT(aw.awd_id) AS award_cnt
FROM actr a
JOIN flm_act fa ON fa.ref1 = a.actr_id
JOIN awd aw ON aw.ref1 = fa.ref1 AND aw.ref2 = fa.ref2
GROUP BY a.actr_id, a.frst_nm, a.last_nm
ORDER BY award_cnt DESC, a.frst_nm ASC, a.last_nm ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT `cust`.`frst_nm` AS `名`, `cust`.`last_nm` AS `姓`, COUNT(`card`.`card_id`) AS `卡数`

GROUP BY `cust`.`cust_id`, `cust`.`frst_nm`, `cust`.`last_nm`
ORDER BY `卡数` DESC, `名` ASC, `姓` ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT c.cty
FROM city c
JOIN addr a ON a.ref1 = c.cty_id
JOIN cust cu ON cu.ref2 = a.addr_id
WHERE cu.cust_id = (
  SELECT p.ref1
  FROM pymt p
  GROUP BY p.ref1
  ORDER BY SUM(p.amt) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT c.cty
FROM (
    SELECT p.ref1 AS cust_id
    FROM pymt p
    GROUP BY p.ref1
    ORDER BY SUM(p.amt) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS top_cust
JOIN cust cu ON cu.cust_id = top_cust.cust_id
JOIN addr a ON a.addr_id = cu.ref2
JOIN city c ON c.cty_id = a.ref1

SELECT c.cty
FROM pymt pm
JOIN card cd ON pm.ref1 = cd.card_id
JOIN cust cu ON cd.ref1 = cu.cust_id
JOIN addr ad ON cu.ref2 = ad.addr_id
JOIN city c ON ad.ref1 = c.cty_id
GROUP BY cu.cust_id, c.cty
ORDER BY SUM(pm.amt) DESC
LIMIT 1
